apps_access_scope_not_grantable: Your role doesn’t include this, so you can’t grant it.
apps_access_install_description: {app} works for the people who use it. It can use the data and actions below, but never more than each person’s role allows.

apps_access_no_scopes: {app} doesn’t use any data or actions in this workspace.

apps_settings_unavailable_description: This app is no longer available. Its earlier connections and imported records stay in Luma.
apps_settings_not_installed: {app} isn’t installed. Install it from Apps to add connections.

apps_settings_result_denied: Authorization was declined, so no connection was added. Add the connection again to retry.
apps_settings_result_failed: Authorization couldn’t be completed. Add the connection again to retry.
apps_settings_pending_access: {app} was updated and asks for more access. It keeps working with its current access until someone approves the change.
apps_settings_manage_denied: Your role can’t add connections or change app settings. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
apps_settings_connections_empty_manage: Add a connection to start using {app}.

apps_settings_access_empty: {app} has no access to workspace data.
apps_settings_add_description: Connect an account so {app} can work with its data.
